programme.title: Yeh Hai Judgementâ€
programme.desc: Ashraf Ansari, a local resident of Mumbai, is taken into custody as a suspect for the bomb blast that shakes the entire city. He battles with the police and the corrupt system to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Blood Relation
programme.desc: Full of action and drama.

programme.title: Chalte Chalte
programme.desc: Geeta is admitted to a mental hospital after her lover passes away tragically. Later, she gains her senses, only to find him alive and in love with another woman.

programme.title: Mr. Natwarlal
programme.desc: When Natwar's elder brother is framed for bribery, he decides to avenge his brother's humiliation and thus poses as a crime lord.

programme.title: Geet
programme.desc: After losing her ability to sing, Neha, a famous star, relocates to a small village. While she attempts to get back her voice, she encounters Rajesh, who decides to help her.

programme.title: Katilon Ke Kaatil
programme.desc: A wealthy widow meets Munna and Ajit and assumes them to be her estranged sons. She takes them into her house, unaware that their intentions are to loot her entire wealth.

programme.title: Jaan Se Pyaara
programme.desc: Inspector Jai arrests Guman only to release him after he threatens to destroy the city. Later, Jai's brother, who has a cognitive disability, gets abducted in return for a mysterious bag.

programme.title: Juaari
programme.desc: Vijay, a young man, resorts to gambling in order to free his lover, Anita, who is held captive by Sanga. He soon runs out of luck when he gets arrested.

programme.title: Wafadaar
programme.desc: Chanda's parents disapprove of her boyfriend Ranga and want her to marry Prasad. Ranga is accused of having an affair with Sita. Chanda faces turmoil in her life.

programme.title: Drishyam
programme.desc: When the disappearance of a policewoman's son threatens to ruin Vijay's family, he leaves no stone unturned in order to shield his family.

programme.title: Pardesi
programme.desc: Myna rescues Ajay, who is bitten by a snake, but he loses his memory. He begins a new life with Myna and her family and the two fall in love, much to her secret lover's outrage.

programme.title: Mast
programme.desc: Kittu is madly in love with Malika, an actress, and travels to her house in Mumbai from Pune after his father scolds him for his decreasing exam scores.

programme.title: Kahani Kismat Ki
programme.desc: A reformed man tries to make an honest living for himself and his family after his jail term. His life takes an ugly turn when a woman claims him to be her husband and he is also framed for murder.

programme.title: Ghatak
programme.desc: When Kashi visits a community with his father, he is shocked to see the torturous regime of Katya. He tries to oppose Katya, but ends up compromising the safety of his family and relatives.

programme.title: Dhadkan
programme.desc: Anjali and Dev are in love with each other and plan to marry, but her family gets her married to Ram. Years later, Dev shows up to reunite with Anjali, however, she has fallen in love with Ram.

programme.title: Ek Se Bure Do
programme.desc: Jagat, a gangster, hires Toti and Tony to steal a treasure map. But they provide him with a fake copy of the map and reserve the original. When Jagat learns about it, he plans to teach them a lesson.

programme.title: Demon
programme.desc: Vignesh Shivan has scary dreams that bother him a lot. However, the strange things in his dreams make him worry and affect his mind.

programme.title: Marshal
programme.desc: A young man puts his life on the line to investigate a hospital run by a crime syndicate that performs various unethical procedures on helpless patients.

programme.title: Agnivarsha
programme.desc: In a kingdom stricken with drought, two rival priests, Yavakri and Parvasu, try to appease the rain god, Indra. However, their efforts result in adultery, treachery and bloodshed.

programme.title: Sweekar Kiya Maine
programme.desc: After Gopika and Kishan get married, she learns that her husband is a widower and has a child. She leaves him but later returns, asking him to accept her son from a previous relationship.

programme.title: Shiva Shakti
programme.desc: Shiva forms a close friendship with Shakti when he comes to the city to earn money for his sister Kusum's wedding. However, he later vows to kill Shakti when Kusum becomes pregnant with his child.

programme.title: Devta
programme.desc: Balram, a rogue, who works for crime lord Bajrang decides to kill inspector Rakesh for sending him to prison. However, he changes his mind when he learns a secret about Rakesh.

programme.title: Market Raja MBBS
programme.desc: While in the pursuit of Raja, a ruthless don, the police accidentally kill Chandrababu, a medical student. Things take a turn when Chandrababu's spirit possesses Raja and turns him into a gentle soul.

programme.title: Kaise Kahoon Ke...Pyaar Hai
programme.desc: Karan, a burglar, wishes to permanently leave his profession when he falls in love with Priya. They decide to get married, but Karan finds out that he has cancer.

programme.title: Powerfull Yoddha
programme.desc: Chandu is very passionate about kickboxing and his life revolves around his mother and his girlfriend. His life is shattered when his dying mother asks him to meet his estranged father Raghuveer.

programme.title: Love Mocktail
programme.desc: After rescuing a woman, Adi reminisces about his love life and tells her about all the heartbreaks he endured in his quest to find his true love.

programme.title: Lashkar
programme.desc: Anand, a professor, meddles with Sangram Singh, a gangster, but he gets acquitted in court. When Sangram seeks revenge, Anand joins hands with a policeman to defeat the crook.

programme.title: Nightbitch
programme.desc: A nameless stay-at-home Mother tends to her young son in the suburbs while Husband casually goes out to work. Dark comedy adapted from Rachel Yoder's novel, starring Amy Adams and Scoot McNairy.

programme.title: The Haunted Mansion
programme.desc: Overworked estate agent Jim Evers takes his beleaguered family to look round an isolated, crumbling mansion - but the resident ghosts are not especially pleased to see the visitors. Comedy based on the Disney theme-park ride, starring Eddie Murphy, Terence Stamp, Jennifer Tilly and Marsha Thomason.

programme.title: Mufasa: The Lion King
programme.desc: Mufasa, a cub lost and alone, meets a sympathetic lion named Taka, the heir to a royal bloodline - a chance meeting which sets in motion an expansive journey of a group of misfits searching for their destiny. Prequel to Disney's live-action 2019 movie, with the voices of Aaron Pierre, Kelvin Harrison Jnr and Tiffany Boone.

programme.title: Maleficent
programme.desc: A fairy falls in love with an ambitious human nobleman, who betrays her in pursuit of claiming the throne. She swears to get revenge on him by placing a curse on his daughter, only to find herself developing a maternal bond with the girl. Fantasy adventure based on the story of Sleeping Beauty, starring Angelina Jolie, Elle Fanning, Sharlto Copley and Imelda Staunton.

programme.title: The Aristocats
programme.desc: A jealous butler is outraged when his employer leaves a vast fortune to her cat and kittens instead of to him, so he drives the pets to the French countryside and dumps them. However, a streetwise alley cat steps in to help the pampered felines find their way home and claim their rightful inheritance. Animated adventure, with the voices of Eva Gabor, Phil Harris and Scatman Crothers.

programme.title: Mulan
programme.desc: A girl poses as a man so she can take her ailing father's place in the army and join in the battle against invading forces - a move that ensures her fame as a national hero. Disney animated adventure based on a Chinese folk tale, featuring the voices of Ming-Na, Eddie Murphy, BD Wong and Miguel Ferrer.

programme.title: Finding Nemo
programme.desc: Clownfish Nemo becomes separated from his friends on the Great Barrier Reef - but the thrill of being able to swim freely and away from his overprotective father turns to horror when he is netted by a diver. His distraught dad sets out on a mission to find him, while the youngster finds himself in a dentist's tropical tank. Animated adventure, with the voices of Albert Brooks, Ellen DeGeneres, Alexander Gould, Willem Dafoe, Barry Humphries and Geoffrey Rush.

programme.title: The Good Dinosaur
programme.desc: In a world where the asteroid impact that wiped out the dinosaurs never happened, humans have evolved as a primitive species while the giant lizards remain the dominant life form on Earth. A young apatosaurus becomes separated from his family, but finds a friend in a feral human boy as he makes the dangerous journey home. Pixar animated adventure, with the voices of Raymond Ochoa and Jack Bright.

programme.title: The Sorcerer's Apprentice
programme.desc: A wizard living secretly in modern-day New York vows to prevent his mystical enemy from taking over the city. Realising that he is unable to complete the task alone, he recruits an ordinary teenager to be his assistant, teaching him to master the magical arts. Fantasy adventure, starring Nicolas Cage, Jay Baruchel and Alfred Molina.

programme.title: Hercules
programme.desc: The son of Zeus, king of the Greek gods, is sent to Earth to be raised as a human. When he learns of his immortal heritage, he discovers he can only reclaim his position among the gods by becoming a true hero, so he embarks on a series of adventures and battles fearsome monsters to prove his worth. Disney animated adventure, with the voices of Tate Donovan, Danny DeVito, James Woods and Rip Torn.

programme.title: Frozen
programme.desc: A princess with the power to freeze anything she touches loses control of her abilities and plunges the kingdom into a perpetual winter. She goes into hiding, but her sister remains determined that she can be saved from her own magic and sets off on a quest to find her, aided by a mountain man and a living snowman. Disney animated fantasy adventure, with the voices of Kristen Bell and Idina Menzel.

programme.title: Black Swan
programme.desc: A repressed ballet dancer leads a sheltered life, devoted entirely to her art. She pursues the lead role in a production of Swan Lake, but the director convinces her she will only be capable of dancing the part if she embraces her darker impulses. This leads her into a destructive relationship with a rival that threatens her sanity. Drama, starring an Oscar-winning Natalie Portman. With Mila Kunis, Vincent Cassel and Winona Ryder.

programme.title: (500) Days of Summer
programme.desc: A greetings card employee looks back on his relationship with the woman he loves, after she has seemingly left him for good. As he recalls the key events of the 500 days he knew her, the ups and downs of their romance are presented in random order. Romantic comedy, starring Joseph Gordon-Levitt and Zooey Deschanel.

programme.title: Solo: A Star Wars Story
programme.desc: Amid emerging demand for hyperfuel and other resources, a headstrong pilot gets mixed up with a bunch of mercenaries, a militant robot, a gambler and a Wookie while attempting to appease a crime lord in an adventure that exposes an underworld's seedy belly. Sci-fi prequel set before the events of Star Wars: A New Hope, starring Alden Ehrenreich, Emilia Clarke, Woody Harrelson, Donald Glover and Paul Bettany.

programme.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programme.desc: The struggling owner of a run-down gym is forced to take drastic action to prevent an arrogant fitness guru buying the business out from under him - and enlists his customers to form a dodgeball team in the hope of triumphing in the US championships. Sporting comedy, starring Ben Stiller, Vince Vaughn and Christine Taylor.

programme.title: Beverly Hills Chihuahua
programme.desc: A pampered pet dog gets separated from her owner, and is left stranded in Mexico struggling to avoid a dognapper and a ferocious Doberman, who are after her diamond collar. Luckily, a courageous German shepherd is on hand to help her get back home. Comedy, starring Piper Perabo and Jamie Lee Curtis, with the voices of Drew Barrymore and Andy Garcia.

programme.title: DuckTales the Movie: Treasure of the Lost Lamp
programme.desc: Scrooge McDuck and great-nephews Huey, Dewey and Louie lead an archaeological expedition to find a long-lost genie's lamp once belonging to a notorious bandit, but reckon without a villainous attempt to use its powers in a dastardly plot. Animated adventure, with the voices of Christopher Lloyd, Alan Young and Russi Taylor.

programme.title: Bambi
programme.desc: A young deer grows up in the forest, forming close friendships with other woodland creatures. When tragedy strikes, he is suddenly forced to fend for himself but ultimately becomes brave and resourceful enough to save his friends during a forest fire. Animated drama, with the voices of Bobby Stewart, Hardie Albright and Donnie Dunagan.

programme.title: Hannah Montana: The Movie
programme.desc: As her pop starlet alter-ego Hannah Montana's fame begins to grow, teenager Miley Stewart gets carried away with the success and is sent to work on the family farm in Tennessee. With help from her faithful friends, she begins to discover who she really is and what is important in life. Family comedy, starring real-life father and daughter Miley and Billy Ray Cyrus, alongside Emily Osment, Jason Earles and Mitchel Musso.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
programme.desc: Four children are evacuated from London during the Second World War and sent to a rural manor house where they discover a secret entrance to the mystical world of Narnia. There they help vanquish the wicked White Witch, whose curse has gripped the land in perpetual winter. Fantasy adventure based on the book by CS Lewis, with Tilda Swinton, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell, William Moseley, James McAvoy and Jim Broadbent, and featuring the voice of Liam Neeson.

programme.title: The Good Dinosaur
programme.desc: In a world where the asteroid impact that wiped out the dinosaurs never happened, humans have evolved as a primitive species while the giant lizards remain the dominant life form on Earth. A young apatosaurus becomes separated from his family, but finds a friend in a feral human boy as he makes the dangerous journey home. Pixar animated adventure, with the voices of Raymond Ochoa and Jack Bright.

programme.title: Aladdin
programme.desc: A street urchin is caught up in a scheming grand vizier's plot to get his clutches on a magical lamp. Retrieving the object from a wondrous cave, he releases a powerful genie trapped inside, whose ability to grant wishes helps the young hero thwart the villain's plans and woo a princess. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Robin Williams, Scott Weinger and Linda Larkin.

programme.title: Monsters, Inc
programme.desc: Two monsters work for an energy firm that employs scary creatures to sneak into children's bedrooms and convert their screams into power. However, when a little girl accidentally wanders into the pair's domain, they have to race against time to return her safely home before anyone finds out. Animated comedy, with the voices of John Goodman, Billy Crystal, Steve Buscemi and James Coburn.

programme.title: Big Hero 6
programme.desc: A lonely, orphaned computer genius forms a special bond with an inflatable robot. When a devastating event occurs in their futuristic home city, they join forces with a group of friends to form a hi-tech band of heroes who are determined to get to the bottom of the matter. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Ryan Potter, Scott Adsit and Daniel Henney.

programme.title: The Princess Diaries
programme.desc: An ordinary teenager discovers she is descended from royal stock and her grandmother is a queen. However, when this formidable regal lady insists she learn to behave like a princess, life suddenly becomes very complicated. Family comedy, starring Anne Hathaway, Julie Andrews, Heather Matarazzo and Hector Elizondo.

programme.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programme.desc: The struggling owner of a run-down gym is forced to take drastic action to prevent an arrogant fitness guru buying the business out from under him - and enlists his customers to form a dodgeball team in the hope of triumphing in the US championships. Sporting comedy, starring Ben Stiller, Vince Vaughn and Christine Taylor.

programme.title: Juno
programme.desc: A teenage girl finds herself pregnant after a one-night stand with her best friend. Deciding to give her baby up for adoption, she thinks she has found the perfect parents in a yuppie couple. However, over the next nine months she begins to experience doubts about her plans. Comedy, starring Elliot Page, Michael Cera, Jennifer Garner and Jason Bateman.

programme.title: Flightplan
programme.desc: A widow boards a plane with her daughter and promptly falls asleep. Thriller, starring Jodie Foster, Peter Sarsgaard, Sean Bean and Greta Scacchi.

programme.title: A Complete Unknown
programme.desc: Nineteen-year-old Bob Dylan arrives in wintry 1961 New York to visit his idol, Woody Guthrie, in self-imposed convalescence at Greystone Park Psychiatric Hospital. An impromptu acoustic performance of a song that Bob has written for Woody propels his star into the ascendancy. Oscar-nominated biopic, starring Timothee Chalamet.

programme.desc: S12 E8 — Bad RomanceFollowing a difficult charter, the crew spends two days off at a lavish villa. Chef Anthony's bitterness from last charter season boils over, Solene and Rainbeau's frustrations with each other come to a head, and Damo violates the bro code.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: S9 E19 — Simpson TideHomer gets into deep water when he joins the naval reserve after getting fired from the nuclear plant.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: S9 E20 — The Trouble With TrillionsHomer and Mr Burns go on the run to Cuba with a trillion-dollar note that Mr Burns stole from the government many years ago.

programme.title: Abbott Elementary
programme.desc: S2 E8 — Egg DropWhen the eighth grade science class participates in an egg drop activity, Janine insists her second grade class join in; Barbara is shocked at the clothing one of her student's parents wears.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: S4 E3 — George! George Glass!Adam risks bodily harm during an intense game of paintball to impress his latest crush. Erica pretends she has a college-aged boyfriend but is embarrassed when her friends see right through her deception. Murray's stubborn behaviour causes Beverly to miss seeing the Beach Boys at Live Aid.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: S4 E4 — Crazy CallsAfter getting telephone answering machines, Murray and Pop-Pop wage a message war on one another, so Erica, Barry and Pops try to reunite them at a hockey game. Adam finds a lunchtime home with some geeks in the school computer room, but Beverly frets about his social standing.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: S2 E21 — Det. Dave MajorsJake is thrilled to work with Detective Dave Majors, until he learns Majors intends to ask Amy out. Charles and Gina want Terry to turn down a job offer at a private firm.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: S2 E22 — The ChopperWhen Wuntch lets Peralta work his dream case, Holt worries she's setting him up to fail. Meanwhile, Amy, Rosa and Gina help Terry host a field trip.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
programme.desc: S3 E8 — Bear's Den PizzaGordon helps revamp Bear's Den Pizza, a pizza restaurant and college bar in Conway, Arkansas. Along with the restaurant's menu and interiors, he will also have to work on fixing the owner's terrible attitude towards their business.

programme.title: Hollyoaks
programme.desc: E80A lavish dinner party at Leah and Imran's new home leads to an evening of soul-searching as secrets are confessed and lies are spun.

programme.title: Hollyoaks
programme.desc: E81As hidden truths begin to surface and long-buried secrets threaten to unravel, friendships are tested, loyalties are pushed to their limits and the consequences of the past come crashing into the present.

programme.title: Hollyoaks
programme.desc: E82School's out for summer, and the teens are quickly up to no good. Frankie tries to prove that Leah knows more than she's letting on. And a new face makes connections.

programme.title: Rude(ish) Tube
programme.desc: ShortsA short clip from Rude Tube's incredibly naughty little sister Rude-ish Tube, featuring food and animals.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: S12 E21 — Simpsons Tall TalesThe Simpsons win a holiday, but Homer refuses to pay the airport tax and decides the family should travel by goods train. On the train, they meet a hobo who regales them with his own versions of classic American tales, starring the Simpsons as, among others, Paul Bunyan, Connie Appleseed and Tom Sawyer.

programme.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E4 — AsturiasJames meets a family who live in Asturias, samples fabada stew and Urbies cheese, and visits a restaurant famous for its sardines. James also cooks a steak sandwich, pancetta and clams in red wine, rice pudding, and sardines with Padrón peppers.

Current World Cup holders Argentina survived an almighty scare in the last round as they came from 2-0 down to win 3-2 against Egypt. The African side had gone two goals ahead with 23 minutes remaining but three goals inside 13 minutes from Cristian Romero, Lionel Messi and Enzo Fernandez saw Argentina progress to their second successive quarter-final in this competition. Switzerland reached their first quarter-final since 1954 after they beat Colombia 4-3 on penalties after the game finished 0-0 in Vancouver. Before Tuesday's victory the European side had reached the round-of-16 at the last three World Cups, but heroics from goalkeeper Gregor Kobel ended that run and helped them reach this stage for the first time in 72 years.

Current World Cup holders Argentina survived an almighty scare in the last round as they came from 2-0 down to win 3-2 against Egypt. programme.title: FIFA WC2026: Argentina v Switz
programme.desc: S5 E50 — Argentina v SwitzerlandArgentina v Switzerland (Kick-off 2.00am). Coverage of the fourth quarter-final, which takes place at Kansas City Stadium in the USA. Current World Cup holders Argentina survived an almighty scare in the last round as they came from 2-0 down to win 3-2 against Egypt. The African side had gone two goals ahead with 23 minutes remaining but three goals inside 13 minutes from Cristian Romero, Lionel Messi and Enzo Fernandez saw Argentina progress to their second successive quarter-final in this competition. Switzerland reached their first quarter-final since 1954 after they beat Colombia 4-3 on penalties after the game finished 0-0 in Vancouver. Before Tuesday's victory the European side had reached the round-of-16 at the last three World Cups, but heroics from goalkeeper Gregor Kobel ended that run and helped them reach this stage for the first time in 72 years.

programme.title: Celebrity Lingo
programme.desc: S2 E10Adil Ray hosts as RuPaul's Drag Race UK stars Tia Kofi and Danny Beard take on former England goalkeeper David Seaman and his wife, Dancing on Ice professional Frankie Seaman, in the game of words. They must try to use their powers of deduction to fill in the blanks and find the missing words in the Lingo grids and Puzzlewords.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026: Argentina v Switz
programme.desc: S5 E50 — Argentina v SwitzerlandArgentina v Switzerland (Kick-off 2.00am). Coverage of the fourth quarter-final, which takes place at Kansas City Stadium in the USA. Current World Cup holders Argentina survived an almighty scare in the last round as they came from 2-0 down to win 3-2 against Egypt. The African side had gone two goals ahead with 23 minutes remaining but three goals inside 13 minutes from Cristian Romero, Lionel Messi and Enzo Fernandez saw Argentina progress to their second successive quarter-final in this competition. Switzerland reached their first quarter-final since 1954 after they beat Colombia 4-3 on penalties after the game finished 0-0 in Vancouver. Before Tuesday's victory the European side had reached the round-of-16 at the last three World Cups, but heroics from goalkeeper Gregor Kobel ended that run and helped them reach this stage for the first time in 72 years.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026: Argentina v Switz
programme.desc: S5 E50 — Argentina v SwitzerlandArgentina v Switzerland (Kick-off 2.00am). Coverage of the fourth quarter-final, which takes place at Kansas City Stadium in the USA. Current World Cup holders Argentina survived an almighty scare in the last round as they came from 2-0 down to win 3-2 against Egypt. The African side had gone two goals ahead with 23 minutes remaining but three goals inside 13 minutes from Cristian Romero, Lionel Messi and Enzo Fernandez saw Argentina progress to their second successive quarter-final in this competition. Switzerland reached their first quarter-final since 1954 after they beat Colombia 4-3 on penalties after the game finished 0-0 in Vancouver. He had wanted to start a new life with his teenage lover, a relationship seemingly condoned by his identical twin Paul, who continues to support him to this day.

programme.title: Buddy Holly: Rave On
programme.desc: Rock 'n' roll started with Elvis, but some believe that pop music started with Buddy Holly and the Crickets. As a songwriter, Holly revolutionised the genre by introducing dynamic new rhythms and unpredictable melodies beyond its traditional blues roots. In his songs written and recorded in the late '50s, it is already possible to hear the beat group sound of the 1960s, and beyond. This documentary tells the story of Holly's tragically short life and career through interviews with those who knew him and worked with him. Contributors include Don McLean, Paul Anka, Don Everly, Hank Marvin and Bob Harris

programme.title: Led Zeppelin: In the Light
